features: Faster baseline combat pace for players, pets, and mobs (+25% player baseline Haste, +25 Store TP, +20 Regain, +15 Fast Cast; +12-25% mob Haste + Regain/Store TP).

Progressive Lv 1-75 boss-like combat modifiers on all normal mobs and NMs (scaling across Spec tiers at Lv 10/30/50/70+), plus level-gap scaling (EM-IT soloable with a good spec but tougher; IT++ at +8 levels is the wall) and anti-one-shot breath/suicide move normalization.
Greatly increased EXP per kill (higher per-monster caps, extended 3x chain timers, boosted chain multipliers, and extra kill multipliers) to compensate for longer, boss-like fights.

Level 99 QoL unlocks (Mog Sack/Case/Safe 2 & Wardrobes 1-8 resized to 80 slots, all 9 Rhapsodies of Vana'diel key items for 5 Trusts + bonuses, all 22 standard jobs unlocked, and all combat/magic skills auto-capped).
BiS Lv.1 All-Jobs Starter Kit (29 items) auto-granted on new characters and existing logins via `!starterkit`.
Lv.1 Weapons Shop (`!weapons`, `!startershop`, & city Starter Weapons Moogles) with Featured BiS/HQ page + 5 full catalog pages (263 weapons).

baselinePlayerPace.desc: Brisk combat speed right from Level 1 without needing endgame Haste gear first.
Faster TP generation on every melee and ranged swing.
Passive TP regeneration while engaged in battle.
Snappier spell casting and shorter recasts across all jobs.

petCombatPace.desc: Applied automatically to all player pets, avatars, automatons, and companions.

qolCards.title: All 22 Jobs Unlocked on Login

qolCards.title: 80-Slot Wardrobes 1–8 & Bags
qolCards.desc: Inventory, Mog Safe 1 & 2, Storage, Locker, Satchel, Sack, Case, and all 8 Mog Wardrobes are expanded to 80 slots automatically.

qolCards.title: 5 Trusts & All 9 Rhapsodies KIs
qolCards.desc: All 9 Rhapsodies of Vana'diel key items are granted on login, allowing up to 5 Trusts in a party immediately.

qolCards.title: 29-Item BiS Lv.1 Starter Kit & 263-Weapon Shop

qolCards.title: Auto-Capped Combat & Magic Skills

qolCards.title: Anti-One-Shot Breath & Suicide Normalization
qolCards.desc: Bomb Toss, Self-Destruct, Mijin Gakure, and HP-scaled breaths are capped to fair percentages of target Max HP.

crystals.name: Commander
crystals.description: Active battlefield tactician (Lv10+): weaves short-cooldown party & mark JAs that scale stronger as you level (Lv10/30/50/70+), shares your active WAR stance with Warcry, and trades swing uptime for JA animation locks.
highlights: Early & Rapid Warcry (Lv10, 60s CD): Shares your single active WAR stance (Berserk, Defender, Aggressor, Retaliation, or Restraint) with the party.
Tactical Breach (Lv10, 20s CD, 10s, Enemy 15y): +12/18/24/30% Skillchain DMG, +8/12/16/20% Magic Burst & Crit DMG, +100/150/200/250 TP on SC close.
Formation: Bulwark (Lv10, 25s CD, 15s, Party 10y): Stacking Phalanx (8 + 0.45*Lv), +5/10/15/20 MDEF, +12/18/25/35 Status Resist, +30/50/75/100% Knockback Resist.
Battle Cadence (Lv10, 20s CD, 12s, Party 10y): +12/18/24/30 Subtle Blow (+0/0/5/10 SB II), +10/15/22/30 Conserve TP, +8/12/16/20% Cure Rcvd.
Rallying Horn (Lv10, 45s CD, 12s, Party 12y): Cleanses Slow/Bind (Lv30+ Weight/Para; Lv50+ DEF/MDEF Down; Lv70+ Atk/Acc Down), +5/7/9/12% HP, +75/125/175/250 TP, +8/10/12/15% Move Speed.

highlights: Passives (Lv10/30/50+): +8/12/16% Attack, +6/10/14% Double Attack, +5/8/12% WS Damage, +5/10/15 Store TP.
Bloodlust Surge (Lv10, 25s CD, 10s, Self): +10/14/18/24% Attack% and +15/22/30/40% Double Attack Damage at -10% DEF%.
Savage Cleave (Lv10, 20s CD, Enemy 4y): Overstraining physical strike (0 TP gained) that inflicts 6/8/10/12% Max HP recoil.
Berserk: +10% extra Attack%, +60s duration, and instantly grants +300 TP on activation.
Aggressor: Removes -25 Evasion penalty and grants +5% Critical Hit Rate.
Blood Rage: +10% extra Critical Hit Rate and +15s duration.

crystals.name: Spartan
crystals.description: Frontline phalanx tank (Lv10+): requires a Polearm paired with a Size-1 Buckler (or an empty SUB for a virtual Aspis Buckler) to unlock Spear-Wall Guard/Block, Spartan's Grit damage-to-barrier conversion, and charge-based Melee & Spell Brace deflection.
highlights: Phalanx Spear & Buckler Mastery: +15/25/35/50 Polearm & Shield skill, +10/16/22/28% Block Rate, +15/25/35/45 Shield TP. Real Size-1 Buckler: +10% Block and Iron Resolve cap 40% Max HP; empty SUB: 10% virtual Aspis Buckler block.
Spartan's Grit: taking damage or blocking grants +1 Grit (max 5). Any Polearm WS consumes all Grit for an Iron Resolve barrier (4/5/6/7% Max HP per stack, cap 35%/40%), heavy enmity, and Maim.
Impaling Thrust (Lv10, 20s CD, Enemy 8y, Polearm): Stun 2s (+5s Silence mid-cast), Maim, +2 Grit (+4 during Defender / Mighty Strikes).
Phalanx Ward (Lv10, 35s CD, 2 Grit, Self 12s, Polearm): +15/22/30/38% Block, -10/12/15/18% DT, +25/35/45/55 Enmity, Knockback Immunity, arms a Heavy Brace.
Spear-Wall Brace: Defender (15s CD) arms a Light Brace (-25% next hit, +1 Grit, Off-Balance). Heavy Brace: -50% next hit, Grit to 5, 2s Stun, Exposed Guard (+4s Silence vs spells).
Tactical Instinct: warns when your target crosses 750 TP or begins casting.
Tier 6 Tank: -60% Physical & Magical Damage Dealt, no negative ATTP/RATTP/WSD penalties.
WAR JAs: Warcry (party -8% DMG, +20 self Enmity, Adrenaline Surge below 50% HP), Provoke (Adrenaline Surge below 50% HP), Mighty Strikes (-25% DT, +50 Enmity, instant 5 Grit).

customAbilities.name: Impaling Thrust
customAbilities.desc: Requires Polearm. High-enmity spear strike that Stuns (2s, +5s Silence mid-cast), applies Maim (-15% ATK / -20 ACC for 15s), and grants +2 Grit (+4 during Defender or Mighty Strikes).

customAbilities.name: Phalanx Ward
customAbilities.desc: Requires Polearm. Grants +15/22/30/38% Block, -10/12/15/18% DT, +25/35/45/55 Enmity, Knockback Immunity, and arms 1 Heavy Brace (-50% next hit, maxes Grit to 5, 2s Stun, Exposed Guard, +4s Silence vs spells).

customTraits.name: Spartan's Phalanx
customTraits.desc: Grants Polearm & Size-1 Buckler Mastery, Spartan's Grit damage-to-barrier conversion, charge-based Melee & Spell Brace deflection, and phalanx mitigation.

crystals.name: Sensei
crystals.description: Agile staff master (Lv10+): evades and parries incoming blows with a Staff, ripostes missed or parried strikes, and anchors aggro through Counterstance.
highlights: Counter & Deflection: +15/30/50 Parry Skill, +5/10/15% Parry Rate, +12/22/30% Counter, +8/16/28 Counter DMG, +15/25/40 Enmity, -25/40/60% Enmity Loss, +6/10/15% HP, -5/8/12% DT.
Staff Riposte (w/ Staff): +12% Parry Rate; Parrying heals 2% Max HP, grants +75 TP, +Enmity, and strikes back. Evading grants 1.5% Max HP, +50 TP, +Enmity, and deals an Evasive Counter.
Iron Counterstance (Lv10, 120s CD): +30% Counter, +20 Counter DMG, -10% DT, +20 Enmity, with no DEF halving penalty.

Tank JAs: Dodge (60s, +25 EVA, +15% EVA, +12% Parry, +15 Enmity, +25% Evasive Counter DMG), Focus (+15% Counter, +15 Parry, +10 Counter DMG), Boost (+15 Enmity, +50 TP), Chi Blast (heavy Enmity + Acc Down), Chakra (+50% heal, Regen, cleanses Slow/Silence), Perfect Counter (45s CD, +25 Counter DMG, +25 Enmity, 5% heal), Mantra (party -5% DT), Inner Strength (60s, -25% DT, +20% EVA%, +30 Counter DMG, +50 Enmity).

customAbilities.name: Iron Counterstance
customAbilities.desc: Unlocked early at Lv.10 on a 120s recast: +30% Counter Rate, +20 Counter DMG, -10% Damage Taken, +20 Enmity, with ZERO Defense penalty.

customTraits.name: Sensei's Flow
customTraits.desc: Mastery of Staff deflection: parrying and evading restore HP/TP, build enmity, and riposte.

crystals.name: Chi Weaver
crystals.description: Bare-handed Chi channeler (Lv10+): cannot equip weapons in Main or Sub slots, firing dual 20y Light Chi bolts and ranged H2H Weaponskills that stack Boost up to 100 for massive 5s-CD Chi Blast 20y party heals.
highlights: Empty-Handed Vow: Cannot equip ANY weapon or item in Main or Sub slots (bare fists only).

Dual-Fist Chi & Boost Stacking (0-20y): Auto-attacks unleash main & off-hand Light Chi bolts (+Kick procs) and ranged H2H Weaponskills work up to 20y. Every landed bolt grants +1 Boost stack (WS +3/+4/+5, max 100, +1 Cure Pot/MACC/MAB per 5 stacks) plus light sustain pulses.
Healer Offense Tradeoff: -20% Attack% & -58% Weaponskill DMG; Light Chi bolts deal light healer chip damage in exchange for party sustain.

Custom JAs (Lv10+): Resonant Chi (20s CD, 20y Light burst + 1.75x target AoE heal & Cleanse), Tranquil Lotus (30s CD, 12y Party/Pet heal + 15s Regen, +Cure Rcvd, & Enmity-), Inner Harmony (45s CD, 18s +Cure Potency, +MAB/MACC, +Ability Haste, +Regen, & +40% Chi Bolt/Pulse power).

Healer MNK JAs: Chi Blast (5s CD, 0 damage, consumes all 0-100 Boost stacks for a massive 20y party AoE heal + up to 3 debuff cleanses), Boost (+5 Boost stacks, +50 TP & light engaged pulse), Focus (+25 MACC, +20 MAB, +15% Cure Pot), Dodge (+30 EVA, -10% DT, -25 Enmity), Chakra (projects 45% AoE heal + self cleanse), Mantra (party Regen + Cure Rcvd%), Formless Strikes (+15% Chi DMG/+20% Pulse), Hundred Fists (2x Chi Bolt speed & +25% Pulse).

customAbilities.name: Resonant Chi
customAbilities.desc: Projects a concentrated Light Chi burst at up to 20y, triggering a 1.75x AoE healing pulse & debuff cleanse around the target mob and granting +125 TP.

customAbilities.name: Tranquil Lotus
customAbilities.desc: Restores 12/16/20/24% Max HP (+MND) to nearby party members, Trusts, and pets, applying a 15s Sanctuary (+12/20/30/42 Regen, +10/15/20/25% Cure Rcvd, -10/14/18/22 Enmity).

customAbilities.name: Inner Harmony
customAbilities.desc: 18s meditative overdrive: +15/22/30/40% Cure Potency, +20/30/45/60 MAB & MACC, +5/8/11/15% Ability Haste, +10/18/28/40 Regen, and +40% Chi Bolt & Pulse potency.

customTraits.name: Chi Weaver's Pulse
customTraits.desc: Empty-handed ranged Light Chi bolts (0-20y) emit a 12y AoE healing pulse around the target mob while mending the Monk at range.

crystals.name: Black Belt
crystals.description: Pure Hand-to-Hand striker (Lv10+): restricted strictly to Hand-to-Hand weapons or bare fists, trading weapon variety for relentless Kick Attacks, Double Attack, Crit, WSD, and TP flow.
highlights: H2H Oath: Restricted strictly to Hand-to-Hand weapons or bare fists (cannot equip Staves, Clubs, or non-H2H weapons in Main/Sub).
Martial Relentlessness: +6/10/15/20% Kick Rate, +8/15/24/35 Kick DMG, +3/5/8/12% Crit Rate, +5/9/14/20 Store TP, +5/10/15/20 Subtle Blow, +6/10/16/22% WSD.
Combo Momentum: Every Hand-to-Hand Weaponskill refunds +75 TP to sustain rapid skillchain pressure.

Aggressive JAs: Boost (+100 TP, +8% Crit & +15% next WSD), Focus (+10% Crit, +15% Crit DMG, +25 Acc), Dodge (+10% Abil Haste, +15 Subtle Blow), Chakra (+30% heal, +150 TP, cleanses Para/Blind/Weight), Chi Blast (+35% DMG, -15% DEF Down, +100 TP), Footwork (+15 Kick DMG, +10% Kick Rate, +10% Atk%), Hundred Fists (+25% Atk%, +15% Crit, +20% DA, +20 Store TP).

customTraits.name: Black Belt's Mastery
customTraits.desc: Pure Hand-to-Hand oath: amplifies Kick Attacks, Double Attack, Critical Hits, WSD, and refunds +75 TP per H2H weaponskill.

crystals.name: Bishop
crystals.description: Proactive Barrier-Cure & Afflatus Solace Conduit (Lv10+): converts Cure healing and overhealing into Solace Ward Stoneskin barriers, weaves Banish/Holy/Club WSs into instant 0-MP Curagas, and protects the party with Divine Veil.
highlights: Passives (Lv10/30/50/70+): +14/18/22/28% HP & MP, +12/18/24/32 MND & VIT, +18/26/34/42% Cure Potency, +15/25/35/45% Fast Cast, -25/35/45/60 Enmity, +4/6/8/12 MP/tick Refresh, +10/14/18/22% Shield Block (Club+Shield), 100% SIRD in Afflatus.
Proactive Afflatus Solace: Unlocked @ Lv10+ (0s CD); Cure I-VI grant Solace Ward barrier (35-50% of heal, cap 30% Max HP) + -8% DT for 8s.
Sacred Grace Smite-Weaving: Banish/Holy or Club/Staff WS grants +1 Sacred Grace (max 3) & +6% Max MP; at 3 stacks, Curaga/Esuna/Auspice triggers a 10s party Regen (15 + 2.2% Max HP/tick).
JA Enhancements: Divine Seal (20s CD, +15% Max HP barrier), Martyr & Devotion (15s CD, 0 self-HP loss), Benediction (100% party heal/cleanse + 50% MP + -25% DT 15s).
Divine Veil (25s CD, 22% HP barrier + -12% DT + +30 MEVA + splash next Cure/Erase/Esuna) & Sanctuary Pulse (20s CD, 25% HP AoE heal + 3-debuff cleanse + 1 Sacred Grace).

Corpse Explosion: Detonate your summon for massive Dark AoE damage.

Hex-Mitigation: reduces target physical & magical damage dealt by 5% per active enfeeble (up to -25%) and grants +3% Parry Rate per enfeeble (+15% max).
Crimson Riposte: parrying triggers light/ice counter-damage, heavy volatile enmity, and restores +4% Max MP.

Beacon of Light: Melee hits and Club WSs heal the lowest-HP ally (12y) for 8/11/14/18% PLD Max HP and restore +5% Max MP.

JA Enhancements: Divine Seal (20s CD, 2-debuff party cleanse), Chivalry (15s CD, 40% MP + 15% AoE heal), Rampart (-15% DT aura), Sanctuary Benediction (replaces Invincible: 100% party heal/cleanse + -20% DT).
Holy Radiance (20s CD, Club+Shield: 25% HP AoE heal + 2-debuff cleanse + 10% MP) & Crusader's Aegis (25s CD, 10s -15% DT + Knockback Immune + 2x Beacon).

Zeal & Holy Retribution (Max 5): Blocking or intercepting grants +1 Zeal; at 5 Zeal, Flash / Shield Bash / Club WS detonates Holy Nova (+8% Max MP, party -10% DT for 8s, heavy enmity).
Club WS Engine & JAs: Club WSs scale off VIT+MND, inflict -15% ATK/MATK Down (Skullbreaker/Brainshaker), and restore party HP/MP; enhances Sentinel, Rampart, Chivalry, and Invincible.

highlights: Auto-attacks with equipped chakram when outside melee range.
Throwing Stance (JA): overrides melee auto-attacks with chakram throws at all ranges.
Unlocks 12 custom Dancer Throwing weaponskills (Lv 5-75).
Steps and offensive Flourishes work up to 20 yalms.
Drain, Aspir, and Haste Samba trigger on ranged chakram hits.
Passive +R.Acc, +R.Atk, +Snapshot, +AGI, and +CHR.

customAbilities.name: Throwing Stance
customAbilities.desc: When active, overrides close-range melee swings so your Dancer throws their equipped Chakram at all ranges (0-20y).

crystals.name: Medic
crystals.description: Light Arts spec: Call Eos faerie companion, safer Sublimation, and automatic Accession for Cure and Regen spells.
highlights: Unlocks Call Eos faerie companion (auto -na/Erase & stackable Regen).
Addendum: White lasts 2 hours.
Sublimation charges 2x faster with no HP drain.
Cure & Regen spells gain free 10y Accession AoE without Stratagem cost.

customAbilities.name: Call Eos
customAbilities.desc: Summons Eos, a Light Arts faerie companion that maintains stackable Regen (I-V) on the party and automatically casts -na spells and Erase.

customTraits.name: Medic's Grace
customTraits.desc: Unlocks Call Eos, 2-hour Addendum: White, HP-free 2x Sublimation, and free 10y Accession on Cure/Regen.

crystals.name: Sage
crystals.description: Dark Arts spec: Call Titania dark faerie companion, permanent Ebullience, stronger Helix spells, and improved elemental casting.
highlights: Unlocks Call Titania dark faerie companion (enfeebling & elemental nuking).
Addendum: Black lasts 2 hours.
Permanent Ebullience active for black magic.
Helix damage +50% and Helix duration extended to 2 hours.
Magic Attack Bonus +30 and elemental spells bypass 10% target MEVA.

customAbilities.name: Call Titania
customAbilities.desc: Summons Titania, a Dark Arts faerie companion (BLM/RDM) that enfeebles targets, casts Drain/Aspir, and unleashes Tier I-V elemental nukes.

customTraits.name: Sage's Wisdom
customTraits.desc: Unlocks Call Titania, 2-hour Addendum: Black, permanent Ebullience, and +50% 2-hour Helix spells.

crystals.name: Verdant
crystals.description: Sylvan Luopan Sanctuary, Living Earth-Pulse & Nature's Renewal Healer (Lv10+): pulses 3s Verdant Bloom heals + MP + Barkskin from your Luopan, and triggers Nature's Surge on Indicolure/Geocolure/Cure/Club/Staff WSs.
highlights: Passives (Lv10/30/50/70+): +14/18/22/28% HP & MP, +12/18/24/32 MND & VIT, +18/26/34/42% Cure & Geomancy Potency, +15/25/35/45% Fast Cast, -25/35/45/60 Enmity, +4/6/8/12 MP/tick Refresh, -50% Luopan Drain.
Living Luopan Sanctuary: Luopan pulses Verdant Bloom every 3s (15y): 6/8/10/12% Max HP heal, +15 MP, and overheal Barkskin Stoneskin (cap 25% Max HP).
Sylvan Resonance: Indi/Geo/Cure or Club/Staff WS heals Luopan to 100% HP and triggers Nature's Surge (16% Max HP party heal + 1-debuff cleanse).
JA Enhancements: Life Cycle (15s CD, 0 self-HP loss + 25% party heal) & Bolster (doubles Verdant Bloom).

Verdant Renewal (20s CD, 30% HP AoE heal + 3-debuff cleanse + 25 + 3.5% Max HP/t Regen + 8/t Refresh 15s) & Canopy of the Ancients (25s CD, 12s -18% DT + Knockback Immune + 10% AoE heal per spell/WS).

customTraits.name: Verdant Trait #175
customTraits.desc: Custom Job Trait #175 unlocked by Verdant.

crystals.name: Spellblade
crystals.description: Elemental Greatsword spellweaver (Lv10+): Enchanted attacks (Rune Edge), Effusion Slash & Overcharge Runes -> Conduction (up to 3) & MP -> Prepared offensive magic (Runic Bolt / Runic Sever) -> Edgeflare (+25% Rune Edge).
highlights: Skills & Passives: Greatsword A+, Elemental Magic A, Enhancing Magic B, +12/20/28/36 MAB, +8/14/20/28 MACC; one Rune Enchantment fills all unlocked slots (1/2/3 at Lv5/35/65).
Rune Edge: First landed normal Greatsword hit per round deals floor((0.08*GS + 0.04*Enh + 4*Runes) * Delay/480) elemental damage (2x during Overcharge Runes) and builds Conduction (max 3) + MP.
Effusion Slash (Lv10, 20s CD, Enemy 4y): Non-consuming Great Sword arcane strike (1.5x-2.8x +20%/Rune) aligned to newest Rune; can Magic Burst (+35% DMG) and grants +100/150/200/250 TP.
Overcharge Runes (Lv10, 30s CD, Self): 12s overdrive granting +15/22/30/40 MAB, +10/14/18/24% Attack%, +15/20/25/30 MB Bonus, 2x Runic Brand damage, and refreshes active Rune durations.

Magic Spell: Runic Bolt (Lv10, 2.0s cast, 8s CD, 8-24 MP, 10y): High-potency arcane bolt scaling with Elemental Skill, Weapon DMG, INT, STR, Runes (+5%/Rune), & Conduction (+10% DMG, -0.5s cast, -15% MP/stack).

Magic Spell: Runic Sever (Lv55, 3.0s cast, 30s CD, 40 MP, 10y): Heavy arcane finisher scaling with Elemental Skill, Weapon DMG, INT, STR, Runes (+8%/Rune), & Conduction (+12% DMG, -0.5s cast, -15% MP/stack); Magic Bursts.

Edgeflare & Kit: Positive damage from Bolt, Sever, or Effusion Slash grants +25% Rune Edge for 12s (Lv30+); Swordplay (+10 ACC/MACC), Vallation, Gambit (1.10x target element DMG), Runic Ascendance (2hr).

customAbilities.name: Effusion Slash
customAbilities.desc: Non-consuming Great Sword arcane strike (1.5x-2.8x +20%/Rune) aligned to your newest Rune element. Can Magic Burst (+35% DMG) and grants +100/150/200/250 TP.

customAbilities.name: Overcharge Runes
customAbilities.desc: 12s overdrive: +15/22/30/40 MAB, +10/14/18/24% Attack%, +15/20/25/30 MB Bonus, 2x Runic Brand damage, and refreshes active Rune durations.

customTraits.name: Runic Brand
customTraits.desc: 3-Rune Mastery at Lv.10+, elemental discharges on every swing/WS, and Mono/Tri-Rune Resonance.

crystals.name: Lifebinder
crystals.description: Keeper of Sacred Yggdrasil Runes (Lv10+): turns Vivacious Pulse into a 15s CD party AoE heal + rune-driven Regen/Cleanse/Refresh/Stoneskin, and projects AoE Regen spells.
highlights: Passives (Lv10/30/50/70+): +10/18/28/35% Max MP, +2/4/7/10 Refresh, +8/16/25/32 MND & VIT, +12/20/30/35% Cure Potency, +15/25/40/50 Enhancing/Divine/Healing Skill, +10/18/25/30% Fast Cast, -15/25/35/40 Enmity.

Sacred Pulse (Vivacious Pulse at Lv10, 15s CD, Party 12y AoE): Party heal + per-Rune boons (Lux: +25% heal & Regen; Unda: Party debuff cleanse; Tenebrae: Caster MP & Party Refresh; Elemental: 25% Stoneskin).
Font of Life (Lv10, 20s CD, Ally 15y): Restores 22/30/38/48% Max HP, cleanses 2 status ailments, and grants -10/14/18/22% DT & +10/15/20/25% Cure Rcvd for 12s.
Sanctified Ward (Lv10, 35s CD, 15s, Party 12y): Instant 10/14/18/22% Party HP heal + 15s Sanctuary (25 + 3.5% Max HP/tick Regen, -8/12/16/20% DT, +15/25/35/50 MEVA).
Runic Lifetap: Melee hits & WSs while holding Runes mend the most injured party member (2.5-5% HP + 0.5*MND) and restore 1-3% Max MP.

AoE Regen & Wards: Regen I-IV project as 10y Party AoE with +50% potency & +60s duration; One for All (60s CD) also heals the party for 18% of your Max HP; Valiance (60s CD) grants +15% Cure Rcvd & Fast Cast.

customAbilities.name: Sacred Pulse (Vivacious Pulse)
customAbilities.desc: Unlocked at Lv.10 on a 15s recast: Party AoE heal + per-Rune boons (Lux: +25% heal & Regen; Unda: debuff cleanse; Tenebrae: MP & Refresh; Elemental: 25% Stoneskin).

customAbilities.name: Font of Life
customAbilities.desc: Restores 22/30/38/48% Max HP, cleanses 2 debuffs, and grants -10/14/18/22% Damage Taken & +10/15/20/25% Cure Potency Received for 12s.

customAbilities.name: Sanctified Ward
customAbilities.desc: Instant 10/14/18/22% Party HP heal + 15s Sanctuary (+10/18/28/40 Regen/tick, -8/12/16/20% Damage Taken, and +15/25/35/50 Magic Evasion).

customTraits.name: Sacred Pulse
customTraits.desc: 3-Rune Mastery at Lv.10+, 15s CD AoE Vivacious Pulse with Rune boons, Runic Lifetap, and AoE Regen.

crystals.name: Inquisitor
crystals.description: Order of Conscience ward tank (Lv10+): harbors 3 Runes at Lv10+, never loses Runes on Swipe/Lunge/Gambit/Rayke, ripostes on Parry, and weaves short-CD Physical Parry & Elemental Aegis stances.
highlights: Parry & Runic Persistence: +12/24/40/50 Parry & Great Sword Skill, +6/10/15/18% Parry Rate (+10% w/ GS); 3 Runes at Lv10+; Swipe/Lunge/Gambit/Rayke preserve Runes & add Enmity.
Runic Riposte: Parrying heals 1.5% Max HP, restores 1% Max MP, grants +50 TP & +Enmity, and deals an elemental counter-slash.
Stance: Iron Battuta (Lv10, 15s CD): +15/22/30/40% Parry Rate, -8/12/16/20% PDT, +15/25/35/50% DEF; swap triggers Steel Flash (+Enmity & 4/6/8/10% HP Stoneskin).
Stance: Runic Aegis (Lv10, 15s CD): -10/15/20/25% MDT/BDT, +20/35/50/70 MEVA, +15/25/35/50 MDEF, +10/15/20/25% Magic Absorb; swap triggers Odyllic Pulse (+Enmity, HP/MP & cleanse).
Runic Convergence (Lv10, 30s CD, 10s): Fuses both stances (-12/16/20/25% DT, +20/30/40/50% Parry, +30/45/60/80 MEVA, +Enmity) and heals 3% HP per Rune.
Tank Tradeoff & JAs: -20% Attack% & -15% WSD; enhances Vallation/Valiance (+10/15/20% DEF), Swordplay (starts at max stacks +15 Enmity), Pflug (-8% PDT), Battuta, and Liement.

customAbilities.name: Stance: Iron Battuta
customAbilities.desc: Physical Parry stance: +15/22/30/40% Parry Rate, -8/12/16/20% PDT, +15/25/35/50% DEF. Swapping stances triggers Steel Flash (AoE Enmity + 4-10% HP Stoneskin).

customAbilities.name: Stance: Runic Aegis
customAbilities.desc: Elemental Ward stance: -10/15/20/25% MDT/BDT, +20/35/50/70 MEVA, +15/25/35/50 MDEF, +10/15/20/25% Magic Absorb. Swapping triggers Odyllic Pulse (Enmity + HP/MP + Cleanse).

customAbilities.name: Runic Convergence
customAbilities.desc: Fuses both stances for 10s (-12/16/20/25% DT, +20/30/40/50% Parry, +30/45/60/80 MEVA, +Enmity) and heals 3% Max HP per active Rune.

customTraits.name: Inquisitor's Ward
customTraits.desc: 3-Rune Mastery at Lv.10+, non-consuming Runes, Runic Riposte on Parry, and dual Tank Stances.

companions.name: Eos (Light Pixie)
companions.role: Party Healer, Regen Buffer & Debuff Cleanser
companions.summary: A true server-side pet (not a Trust) that scales deterministically to the Scholar's level. Automatically maintains a custom stackable Eos Regen (status #789, tiers I–V) across the master, party members, and Trusts, and prioritizes removing debuffs with Poisona, Paralyna, Blindna, Silena, Stona, Viruna, Cursna, and Erase.
companions.specialItem: Orphic Egg (#18256): Repurposed as a SCH-only Ammo item that grants level-scaling Refresh to Eos & Titania.

companions.name: Titania (Dark Pixie)
companions.role: Dark Arts Enfeebler, Drain/Aspir & Elemental Nuker
companions.summary: A Dark Arts faerie companion summoned at the Scholar's exact level. Automatically locks onto the Scholar's spell target, weakens enemies with enfeebling magic, sustains herself with Drain/Aspir, and casts Tier I–V elemental nukes.
companions.specialItem: Orphic Egg (#18256): Grants level-scaling MP Refresh to Titania.

companions.name: Undead Warrior & Dullahan
companions.summary: Melee undead thralls that hold enmity, activate the Necromancer's Dark Pact (+Double Attack, +Store TP, +Accuracy), receive healing from Harbinger's Drain on every Scythe weaponskill, and execute Grim Reaping on command (or detonate via Corpse Explosion).
spells: Grim Reaping (30s CD physical cleave + self-heal)
Corpse Explosion (45s CD Dark AoE detonation)
companions.specialItem: All Scythes unlocked for BLM with A+ Scythe Skill when Necromancer is socketed.

companions.name: Undead Mage & Corse
companions.role: Backline Dark Caster & MP Siphon Thrall
companions.summary: Caster undead thralls with custom dark/elemental spell lists (601/602). Maintain Dark Pact for the Necromancer and unleash Grim Incantations on command, dealing Dark magic damage while siphoning MP back to the Black Mage.
spells: Grim Incantations (30s CD Dark burst + Master MP drain)
Corse Bonus: +40% DMG & inflicts Magic Defense Down (-15%)
Corpse Explosion (45s CD Dark AoE detonation)
companions.specialItem: Grim Conversion Trait: Converts BLM's MACC->ACC, MAB->ATT, Fast Cast->Haste, and MB Bonus->WSD.

customTraits.name: Commander's Tactics
customTraits.desc: Unlocks short-cooldown tactical battle cries and single-stance Warcry sharing at Lv.10+.

customTraits.name: Berserker's Fury
customTraits.desc: Amplifies Attack%, Double Attack, Weaponskill Damage, and Berserk/Blood Rage ferocity.

customTraits.name: Spartan's Phalanx
customTraits.desc: Grants Polearm & Size-1 Buckler Mastery, Spartan's Grit damage-to-barrier conversion, charge-based Melee & Spell Brace deflection, and phalanx mitigation.

customTraits.name: Sensei's Flow
customTraits.desc: Mastery of Staff deflection: parrying and evading restore HP/TP, build enmity, and riposte.

customTraits.name: Medic's Grace
customTraits.desc: Unlocks Call Eos, 2-hour Addendum: White, HP-free 2x Sublimation, and free 10y Accession on Cure/Regen.

customTraits.name: Sage's Wisdom
customTraits.desc: Unlocks Call Titania, 2-hour Addendum: Black, permanent Ebullience, and +50% 2-hour Helix spells.

customTraits.name: Bladewheel Mastery
customTraits.desc: Enables ranged Chakram auto-attacks, 20y Steps/Flourishes/Sambas, and 12 custom Throwing weaponskills.

customTraits.name: Harbinger's Drain
customTraits.desc: Weaponskill damage heals your active Undead summon and fuels Dark magic synergy.

customTraits.name: Dark Pact
customTraits.desc: While an Undead thrall is active, grants scaling Double Attack, Store TP, and Accuracy.

customTraits.name: Grim Conversion
customTraits.desc: Converts Magic Accuracy -> Accuracy, MAB -> Attack, Fast Cast -> Haste, and MB Bonus -> WSD.

customTraits.name: Inquisitor's Ward
customTraits.desc: 3-Rune Mastery at Lv.10+, non-consuming Runes, Runic Riposte on Parry, and dual Tank Stances.

customTraits.name: Runic Brand
customTraits.desc: 3-Rune Mastery at Lv.10+, elemental discharges on every swing/WS, and Mono/Tri-Rune Resonance.

customTraits.name: Sacred Pulse
customTraits.desc: 3-Rune Mastery at Lv.10+, 15s CD AoE Vivacious Pulse with Rune boons, Runic Lifetap, and AoE Regen.

customTraits.name: Black Belt's Mastery
customTraits.desc: Pure Hand-to-Hand oath: amplifies Kick Attacks, Double Attack, Critical Hits, WSD, and refunds +75 TP per H2H weaponskill.

customTraits.name: Chi Weaver's Pulse
customTraits.desc: Empty-handed ranged Light Chi bolts (0-20y) emit a 12y AoE healing pulse around the target mob while mending the Monk at range.

customTraits.name: Ronin's Mushin
customTraits.desc: Requires Great Katana: unlocks multi-charge Mind's Eye counter-anticipation, Mushin Stagger damage deferral, and Seigan mitigation.

customTraits.name: Oisoya Mastery
customTraits.desc: Raises Archery to A+ with 100% arrow preservation, 20y Bow auto-attacks, zero point-blank penalty, and Drawn Oisoya <-> Cosmic Brand combos.

customTraits.name: Onimaru's Command
customTraits.desc: Requires Great Katana: empowers 20s Hagakure Iaijutsu Sundering Draw-Slashes, party-sharing Ashura's Edge stacks, and Onimaru Blood-Quench party HP/MP/TP Skillchain surges.

commands.summary: Backup menu to equip a Size-1 Buckler in the Sub slot alongside a
Party-size-aware leveling & Lv.75 merit camp warp menu for OverlordsXI.
Controls Scholar's Eos (Medic) or Titania (Sage) faerie companion.
Auto-grants and equips a full 16-slot level-appropriate gear loadout tailored to your Job, active Crystal Spec, Role, and Weapon.
Interactive Job Crystal / Soul Spec selector menu, CLI inspector, and Ashita v4 [OXSPEC] sync.
Spec-adaptive Weaponskill Talent Tree builder (4 Tiers, 56 pts per WS, Tier-1 WS unlock, Skillchain selector) & Ashita v4 0x1FD binary /talents UI bridge.
usage: !talent add <ws_key_or_id> <node_key> (use !talent info <ws> to see node keys)

commands.summary: Opens the 263-weapon Lv.1 Starter Shop anywhere, re-grants the 29-item BiS Lv.1 Starter Kit, or inspects combat scaling.

patches.title: Allow Eos Custom Pet And Effect Ids
patches.description: raises `MAX_PETID` from `128` to `129` and `MAX_EFFECTID` from `814` to `815`.

patches.title: Eos Deterministic Level And Subjob
patches.description: makes Eos spawn at the master's level and correctly initializes her SCH main job / SMN subjob levels.

patches.title: Unlock All Player Weaponskills
patches.description: unlocks all implemented player weaponskills at level 1 for any job wielding that weapon type (excluding NPC/event/unimplemented WSes).

patches.title: Dynamic Ws Skillchain Traits
patches.description: reads per-cast `OX_WS_SC1..3` localVars inside `CCharEntity::OnWeaponSkillFinished` so talent-upgraded skillchain properties apply dynamically on each weaponskill.

patches.title: Clear Ws Skillchains Dynamically
patches.description: clears/overrides WS skillchain slots cleanly when `OX_WS_SC_SET` is present.

patches.title: Eos Status Effect Params
patches.description: configures status effect IDs `789` (stackable Eos Regen) and `814` (hidden faerie Refresh/buff carrier) in C++.

patches.title: Spec Ability Unlocks
patches.description: hooks `xi.overlords.spec.getExtraAbilities` into `charutils::BuildingCharAbilityTable` (so crystal-gated JAs like **Call Eos**, **Call Titania**, Commander WAR's **Warcry** / custom JAs, and Sensei MNK's **Counterstance** remain hidden until unlocked at Lv.10+) and syncs ability recasts in `recalculateAbilitiesTable()`.

patches.title: Titania Sage Pet
patches.description: raises `MAX_PETID` to `130` (`PETID_FAERIE_TITANIA = 129`) and deterministically spawns Titania at the master's level with `BLM` main job and `RDM` subjob.

patches.title: Crystal Socket Packets
patches.description: adds custom packets `0x11F` (`GP_CLI_COMMAND_CRYSTAL_SOCKET`, C2S) and `0x1FF` (`GP_SERV_COMMAND_CRYSTAL_COLLECTION` `CRYS` / `GP_SERV_COMMAND_CRYSTAL_CATALOG` `CRYC`, S2C) backed by `xi.overlords.spec` for the Ashita v4 `crystalsocket` Equipment UI.

patches.title: Spec Trait Sync And Unlocks
patches.description: expands `MAX_TRAIT_ID` / `CCharEntity::m_TraitList` to `256` (`32` bytes matching `GP_SERV_COMMAND_COMMAND_DATA`), overrides `CCharEntity::hasTrait`, refreshes spec crystal mods/listeners/UI on every `charutils::BuildingCharTraitsTable` rebuild (job change, subjob change, level change, level sync), and injects crystal-gated custom Job Traits (`xi.overlords.spec.getExtraTraits`) directly into the Traits menu.

patches.title: Commander Status Effects
patches.description: raises `MAX_EFFECTID` to `832` and configures custom status effect IDs `815`â€“`826` (`commander_breach`, `commander_bulwark`, `commander_cadence`, `commander_regroup`, `berserker_bloodlust`, `gladiator_bastion`, `inquisitor_battuta`, `inquisitor_aegis`, `inquisitor_converge`, `spellblade_overcharge`, `lifebinder_font`, `lifebinder_sanctuary`).

patches.title: Dot Damage Log
patches.description: attributes player/pet/trust DoT ticks on mobs (`Dia`, `Bio`, `Poison`, `Burn`/`Frost`/`Choke`/`Rasp`/`Shock`/`Drown`, `Requiem`, `Kaustra`, `Geo-Poison`, `Helix`) and emits parser-friendly `0x017` `MESSAGE_SYSTEM_3` combat log lines (`"<Caster>'s <Effect> deals <Amount> point(s) of damage to <Mob>."`).

patches.title: Throwing Weaponskills
patches.description: Registers the 12 custom Dancer Throwing weaponskills (#241–#252) in data/weapon_skills.yaml.

patches.title: Auto Ranged Attack
patches.description: Enables automatic ranged attacks while engaged when a ranged spec (such as DNC Bladewheel) is active.

patches.title: Dnc Ranged Dances
patches.description: Allows Steps and Flourishes to execute at ranged distances up to 20 yalms when Bladewheel is socketed.

patches.title: Eos Jugpet Spells And Skills
patches.description: Configures deterministic spell lists and AI casting cooldowns for Eos and Titania faerie pets.

patches.title: Blm Necromancer Pets
patches.description: Configures custom Undead Warrior, Undead Mage, Corse, and Dullahan pet IDs (130–133) for BLM Necromancer.

patches.title: Search Job Labels
patches.description: Streams active OverlordsXI Soul Crystal spec labels in `/search` and party search results.

patches.title: Talent Ws Unlocks
patches.description: Gates Weaponskill usage until at least 1 Tier-1 Talent Point is invested and adds the `0x1FD` (`OXTL`) binary packet for instant Ashita `/talents` UI syncing.

patches.title: Aoe Healing Affect Pets
patches.description: Allows custom party AoE healing abilities (such as RUN Lifebinder's Sanctified Ward) to affect pets and avatars.

patches.title: Mnk Chiweaver Ranged Chi
patches.description: Enables unarmed ranged Chi bolt auto-attacks (0–20y), custom effects 829–830, and party/pet AoE reach for MNK Chi Weaver.

patches.title: Run Overcharge Effect
patches.description: Registers RUN Spellblade Overcharge Runes custom effect ID 831 cleanly and raises MAX_EFFECTID to 832.

patches.title: Brd Spec Effects
patches.description: Raises MAX_EFFECTID to 840 and registers BRD spec status effects 832–836.

patches.title: Sam Spec Effects
patches.description: Raises MAX_EFFECTID to 848 and registers SAM spec status effects 837–841 (ronin_stagger, imp_drawn_oisoya, imp_cosmic_brand, warlord_noto, warlord_ashura).
